findings.title: Module lint crashes with an opaque TypeScript 'Debug Failure' on a declaration-file name (*.d.ts / *.d.mts / *.d.cts) instead of reporting a diagnostic. walk() collects every name matching CODE_FILE = /\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/ (apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts:182), so a module file such as types.d.ts is scanned; fileViolations() -> syntaxErrors() (:449-450) calls ts.transpileModule(source, { fileName }) and TypeScript throws 'Debug Failure. Output generation failed' for a declaration-file name. moduleViolations() therefore throws, and architecture.test.ts errors instead of listing violations. Fail-closed (CI goes red, nothing slips through), pre-existing since r5 (42b3dda introduced syntaxErrors), and outside the F-DG1-135 change.
findings.reproduction: Candidate sha256:dd747fe1...c8559, full disposable clone at 985d0fa, Node v22.22.2. (1) fileViolations("transformations", <MODULES_DIR>/transformations/zz.d.ts | zz.d.mts | zz.d.cts | zz.test.d.ts, any source) throws Error 'Debug Failure. Output generation failed' at architecture.testkit.ts:450 (ts.transpileModule). (2) Planting apps/api/src/modules/transformations/zz-qa-r14.d.ts with `export declare const x: number;` makes moduleViolations("transformations") throw the same error. Pinned by the OBSERVATION cases in docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/dg1-r14-test-classification-probe.test.ts (3 cases, green on Node 22 and 24 = the throw reproduces). First observed when my near-miss case used the name zz.test.d.mts (log 06-r14-probe-and-architecture-*.log header).
findings.expected: A declaration file in a module is either skipped explicitly (it emits no JS) or scanned with a mode that works for declaration files (e.g. ts.createSourceFile + parseDiagnostics instead of transpileModule), and a self-check pins the choice. A violation should surface as a named lint diagnostic, never as an internal compiler assertion.
findings.actual: Any *.d.ts / *.d.mts / *.d.cts under apps/api/src/modules makes the whole module-boundary check crash with 'Debug Failure. Output generation failed', with no file name in the message. Today the real tree has no declaration file (0 violations, all module files .ts), so no current check is red.

history.note: Raised by qa-verifier in DG1 round 14 while independently probing the F-DG1-135 test classification. Rated Low and non-mandatory: fail-closed (the lint crashes red, nothing passes unchecked), and declaration files emit no runtime code. No access-control, integrity, calculation or portability impact; it is a developer-experience/robustness defect of a static test-only check. Pre-existing since r5, not introduced by F-DG1-135. Proposed ID F-DG1-217 (next free number in the 2xx range); the orchestrator may renumber. It does not block DG1 on its own; the orchestrator may route it as a repair or accept it as an observation.
